title: chore(pm): move the contract-review tier to the next Fable release
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9Pg36y6wuixyKQbrep1HVyr)_

No card: a direct maintainer order, quoted verbatim (2026-11-09 22:58Z):

> 复审档位要从 Fable 5.1 改到 5.2

## What changes

`CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` in `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs` moves one Fable release up (5.1 to 5.2). Per the constant's own docblock it is the only value site for the tier across `scripts/pm/**` and `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/**`; `git grep` confirms no other copy. `TIER_CEILING`, the clause-① mandate rows, the self-test comparisons and the skill prose all read it, so nothing else moves. The id was checked against the current Anthropic model table before writing it.

## Why

The maintainer's ruling moves the review tier. The docblock's rule is that a tier moves only on the maintainer's explicit word, and that word is quoted above.

## Note for seats: the subagent alias cannot pin a minor release

A seat that renders a review through an at-tier subagent can only choose the model alias `fable`; it cannot name a minor release. The served-tier comparison against this constant is EXACT. So a review rendered through that alias meets the new tier only while the alias resolves to the 5.2 release. A seat whose served model reads as 5.1 after this lands must treat that as "tier not served" (wait or hand off per the rulebook), not as a reason to edit this line back.

## Verification

- `pnpm check:pm-record-recognisers`, `check:pm-skill-id-lint`, `check:pm-skill-ratchet`, `node scripts/check-commit-card-trailers.mjs --self-test`: all green.
- `pnpm check:pm-dispatch-gates`: 2199 of 2205 pass. The 6 failures are the two corpus-reader cases that exit 3 with "install the workspace first" (this container has no installed workspace); none touches the tier.
- `node scripts/pm/check-governed-merges.mjs --test scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs`: not a governed surface. Opened as draft anyway, since it moves the lane's review tier.

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

No changeset: the diff is `scripts/pm` only and publishes nothing (`skip-changeset`).
